title: The wicked Nawab must be given a live demonstration

blocks.text: Once the Khalsa had settled the conditions, the Nawab’s terror of death drove him to seek protection of Guru Granth Sahib and to ask how relief might come. The Singhs answered that his cure must itself demonstrate the spiritual authority he had mocked and persecuted.

Five devout Singhs were appointed to pray that he be touched by Bhai Taru Singh’s shoe, that his blockage be released, and that his life end before Taru Singh’s own final departure. Subeg Singh carried that hukam to Lahore and then to Bhai Taru Singh, who accepted the Panth’s command without hesitation.

The page thus turns the Nawab’s suffering into an enacted lesson about Sikh authority. The cure would not come through court medicine or clerical prestige, but through the very martyr whose humiliation the state had tried to enforce.
